old_caption: The video captures a dramatic scene set in a snowy landscape, featuring a dense line of tall pine trees in the background. The ground is blanketed in snow, creating a serene winter setting. As the video progresses, a large plume of white smoke expands from the right side of the frame, billowing outwards and obscuring part of the view. The smoke continues to rise and spread, partially covering the trees and the snowy ground. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on capturing the unfolding event without any noticeable movement or change in angle. The overall atmosphere is one of sudden disruption amidst the otherwise tranquil winter scene.

The ground is blanketed in snow, creating a serene winter setting. As the video progresses, a bright flash of light appears on the right side of the frame, indicating an explosion or a similar event. This initial burst of light is followed by a large plume of white smoke that billows outwards, expanding rapidly and obscuring part of the view. The smoke continues to rise and spread, partially covering the trees and the snowy ground. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on capturing the unfolding event without any noticeable movement or change in angle. The overall atmosphere is one of sudden disruption amidst the otherwise tranquil winter scene.
caption: The video captures a winter landscape where a snow-covered field with faint tracks lies before a dense line of dark pine trees under a pale overcast sky. Near the right side of the tree line, a large billowing white cloud of disturbed snow sits low to the ground and occupies much of the right side. This cloud continues to grow, its upper boundary rising and its volume expanding. It stays anchored near the trees rather than drifting across the field. Countless bright particles are ejected upward and outward, forming a spray that broadens and thins as it moves toward the upper left. The cloud's silhouette deforms as it billows, with lobes merging and its top edge becoming taller and more diffuse. The background remains broadly stable, with no obvious camera movement, and the disturbance continues.

This is a TEMPORALLY CROPPED EXCERPT from a longer video, not a complete event or a loop.
The first view may already be mid-action; the last view need not contain completion. Different
endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.
Do not claim contact, bending, compression, melting, disintegration or structural recovery unless
the appropriate material/surface itself provides visible evidence. Do not infer a force or earlier
collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.
Compare several frames before asserting translation, rotation, direction, unchanged position or
camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

Retain the WISA English narrative style, detail density and paragraph structure. Aim for the
provided original word count within 85%-115%, using genuinely visible details and process.
Do not add repetition, watermark/logo descriptions or atmospheric filler to reach a word count.

'this mid-segment', 'the excerpt', 'the frame', 'these images', 'observed evidence' in the caption.
This is a direct video description, not an analysis note. No mandatory beginning/end formula.
Complete every sentence. If accuracy requires a substantial length difference, explain it outside
the caption; do not fill missing context by imagination. Optional synonym edits are not needed.
